assessments.reasoning: The cover and preface identify the dated collection and its initial Alto programming-system scope. The addendum’s signed first page places the language manual’s intended language representation at the anticipated first-quarter transfer. It separately identifies differences between the current language and the manual’s description and identifies the reference grammar as current. Section A.2 identifies the grammar included in that addendum. The dated documents establish a stated forward-looking plan with a distinct language subject.

limitations: The first-quarter 1977 compiler transfer is the addendum’s prospective reference point. The evidence establishes the stated plan and the manual’s subject. Actual transfer, delivery, and resulting implementation behavior require separate evidence.

The collection’s initial-release description and the addendum’s language comparison establish distinct documentary scopes. They do not establish the full contents of the standalone manual or compatibility with the initial Alto system.
